intro_text:
This tool helps transport planners, financiers, and policymakers explore how a small share of a larger transport project budget (like a large corridor investment) could fund essential Rural Networked Transport Infrastructure (RNTI) — the trail bridges, footpaths, low-water crossings, ancillary safety, and active mobility components that connect rural communities to primary networks. RNTI is defined and detailed in Segerberg & Noriega (2026), Advancing Inclusive, Multimodal, Climate-Resilient Planning for Rural Networked Transport Infrastructure.

The calculator is designed to raise awareness of how modest, evidence-based RNTI add-ons — typically 1% to 10% of a transport project budget — can meaningfully improve resilience, market access, and equity outcomes for the roughly 3 billion people living in rural/semi-rural areas worldwide.

To use the tool, enter your total project budget, the percentage you want to allocate to RNTI, and an optional maintenance reserve. Then enter quantities next to any of the RNTI components you would like to fund. The calculator returns total estimated costs, a remaining budget, and a summary of your allocation. Unit cost ranges are approximations using blended averages from available, verifiable sources. This version is an illustrative, back-of-the-envelope tool using high-level cost estimates.
disclaimer: This is an initial version of the Rural Connectivity Budget Tool. Estimated budgets are approximations based on blended averages of publicly available cost data and may not reflect local market conditions, terrain, labor rates, or design specifications in any specific country or project. Fika will integrate more nuanced cost approximations and social and climate impact information in future iterations of this tool. Suggestions, corrections, additional cost data, and inquiries are warmly welcomed — contact our research team here.

source.Source Item Title: Geo Cell / Engineered Slope Stabilization (per site)
source.Full Citation:
Total Cost Range (Materials): $0.40–$4.50 per square foot.
Total Cost Range (Including Installation): $0.90–$6.50 per square foot. For a 100 sq m site (≈ 1,076.39 sq ft):
Materials only ($0.40–$4.50/sq ft):

Low end: ~$430
High end: ~$4,844

Including installation ($0.90–$6.50/sq ft):

Low end: ~$969
High end: ~$6,996

So a 100 sq m geocell slope-stabilization site would likely fall somewhere in the ~$1,000 to ~$7,000 range all-in, with most rural projects clustering in the lower-to-middle portion of that range (rural labor rates are at the lower end, and HDPE in shallow cell depths is typically toward the middle of the materials range).
